integrity: Proof uses a published strict compound-Poisson log-concavity result and an independently reproducible exact modular polynomial certificate; neither numerical sampling of intensity values nor an independent audit is presented as proof.
scientific_limitations: Proves at most two global modes for orders 2 through 8 and all positive equal component intensities; does not prove the statement for orders 9 onward, unequal rates, or actual modal transition locations. Previously established strict log-concavity at large intensities is explicitly credited.
title: No triple global mode in the first eight Poisson orders
